details.description: Fresh read-only production check before this API-only tool-call recovery deployment.

details.artifact_source: git archive/package from the frozen source revision
details.focused_tests: agent progress ledger and tool-call recovery contract tests passed
details.syntax_checks: all candidate JavaScript and shell scripts passed

change_summary.expected_result: When an Agent model calls an unavailable PowerShell or Glob alias, or sends malformed/truncated code-tool arguments, the API returns a clear recoverable message naming the registered Linux tools and /mnt/data boundary. Truncated bash scripts receive a bounded split-call hint, without implicit shell execution or raw argument logging.
functions: Add a dependency-free tool-call recovery helper for unknown tools and incomplete arguments
Keep PowerShell and Glob unregistered and provide exact registered-tool guidance
Validate code/file tool argument shape before invoking handlers
Annotate likely truncated bash syntax failures with a short-call recovery hint
Expose the active tool registry in unknown-tool errors without raw arguments
Extend the public code-tool contract with Linux, /mnt/data, and script-splitting rules
Preserve legacy Bash, Read, and Skill normalization including JSON-string arguments
limitations: This release does not add PowerShell or Glob capabilities and does not grant host-disk access
The code sandbox remains Linux and isolated; uploaded/generated files must use /mnt/data
The runner recreates only LibreChat-API and does not modify MongoDB configuration
A production model request is limited to one non-destructive request during acceptance
change_summary.reason: The supplied conversation reported that the Agent could not read a disk or execute scripts. Logs and runtime behavior show the model called unregistered PowerShell and Glob aliases and emitted a truncated bash_tool payload; the failure was a tool contract and argument-recovery problem, not a disk permission or CodeAPI outage.
change_summary.risk: API Agent tool execution and user-facing error text change. The patch is dependency-free, never maps unknown names to shell commands, validates required string fields before invocation, logs only bounded shapes, locks the known production API baseline, and recreates only LibreChat-API with an exact Compose rollback.

details.method: The versioned runner saves the exact production compose.override.yaml before the write, restores it on failure or rollback, and recreates only LibreChat-API.

validation_plan.expected: Only LibreChat-API is recreated; candidate module hashes match in-container; CodeAPI identity/start time and other protected services remain unchanged; root and /api/config return 200.

validation_plan.expected: Unknown PowerShell/Glob and malformed bash-tool failures are actionable, no host path is attempted, and no unrecoverable tool-not-found or truncated-payload loop is observed.
